title: Inception
selection_rationale: Complex multi-layered narrative, high-budget sci-fi heist, Christopher Nolan auteur direction.
evaluation_notes: Tests ability to retrieve cerebral, structure-heavy sci-fi over generic action/heist films.

title: The Dark Knight
selection_rationale: Neo-noir crime drama within a comic book franchise, dense psychological antagonism.
evaluation_notes: Tests tone and psychological conflict matching vs. superficial superhero action.

title: Interstellar
selection_rationale: Hard sci-fi, space exploration, intense familial emotional grief, relativistic physics.
evaluation_notes: Tests scientific exploration themes intertwined with intimate human relationship dynamics.

title: The Matrix
selection_rationale: Cyberpunk philosophical action, dystopian reality simulation, martial arts fusion.
evaluation_notes: Tests philosophical sci-fi and simulated reality matching vs. standard gunplay/action.

title: Jurassic Park
selection_rationale: Sci-fi adventure, creature horror, hubris of technological cloning, suspense thriller.
evaluation_notes: Tests bio-ethical thriller and survival suspense matching vs. fantasy creature features.

title: Gladiator
selection_rationale: Roman antiquity epic, revenge tragedy, honor and political betrayal.
evaluation_notes: Tests historical revenge and swords-and-sandals epic matching vs. fantasy warfare.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
selection_rationale: High fantasy, mythic quest, extensive ensemble lore, Tolkien worldbuilding.
evaluation_notes: Tests mythic quest and high fantasy narrative semantics vs. modern urban fantasy.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
selection_rationale: Large-scale ensemble crossover, apocalyptic stakes, cosmic villain perspective.
evaluation_notes: Tests ensemble narrative and tragic cliffhanger resolution matching.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
selection_rationale: Minimalist dialogue, relentless visual kinetic action, feminist wasteland survival.
evaluation_notes: Tests kinetic pacing, vehicular combat, and post-apocalyptic narrative tone.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
selection_rationale: Aviation procedural, legacy sequel, mentorship, high-g aerial combat.
evaluation_notes: Tests legacy sequel and military aviation drama matching.

title: Parasite
selection_rationale: South Korea: Social class satire, home infiltration, dark thriller, tragicomic shift.
evaluation_notes: Tests dark socioeconomic satire and architectural suspense in non-English cinema.

title: Spirited Away
selection_rationale: Japan (Anime): Mythological folklore, coming-of-age, surreal bathhouse spirits.
evaluation_notes: Tests Shinto animism, liminal fantasy, and Studio Ghibli narrative resonance.

title: City of God
selection_rationale: Brazil: Favela crime chronicle, multi-decade drug turf warfare, hyperkinetic editing.
evaluation_notes: Tests realistic urban poverty crime docudrama matching across languages.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
selection_rationale: Spain: Post-Civil War fascist cruelty juxtaposed with dark subterranean fairy tale.
evaluation_notes: Tests historical trauma intertwined with dark mythological escapism.

title: Amélie
selection_rationale: France: Whimsical romantic comedy, poetic urban Paris, quirky observational vignettes.
evaluation_notes: Tests stylized whimsical romanticism and idiosyncratic comedic tone.

title: The Lives of Others
selection_rationale: Germany: East German Stasi surveillance, moral redemption, artistic empathy.
evaluation_notes: Tests cold war espionage, voyeuristic intimacy, and moral awakening themes.

title: Seven Samurai
selection_rationale: Japan: Feudal period jidaigeki, rural defense, tactical ensemble recruitment.
evaluation_notes: Tests foundational archetypal team recruitment and sacrificial honor narratives.

title: Cinema Paradiso
selection_rationale: Italy: Nostalgic ode to film projection, childhood mentorship, lost love drama.
evaluation_notes: Tests meta-cinematic romantic nostalgia and small-town Italian cultural identity.

title: Oldboy
selection_rationale: South Korea: Extreme vengeance tragedy, psychological captivity, Greek incest motif.
evaluation_notes: Tests extreme psychological horror, vengeance, and transgressive shock drama.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
selection_rationale: France: Quiet 18th-century female romance, artistic gaze, solitary Brittany coast.
evaluation_notes: Tests restrained historical queer romance, gaze dynamics, and sparse dialogue.

title: Whiplash
selection_rationale: Auteur jazz conservatory chamber drama, abusive pedagogical obsession, psychological duel.
evaluation_notes: Tests intense psychological pressure and toxic artistic perfectionism.

title: Her
selection_rationale: Near-future melancholic sci-fi romance, AI consciousness connection, modern loneliness.
evaluation_notes: Tests soft philosophical sci-fi and existential romantic alienation.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
selection_rationale: Wes Anderson aesthetic diorama, whimsical farce, interwar nostalgic melancholia.
evaluation_notes: Tests highly stylized geometric framing, deadpan comedy, and elegiac nostalgia.

title: Moonlight
selection_rationale: Triptych coming-of-age drama, queer Black identity, vulnerability under masculine expectation.
evaluation_notes: Tests poetic naturalistic drama, identity struggle, and lyrical pacing.

title: Drive
selection_rationale: Minimalist neo-noir, laconic stunt driver, violent synthwave Los Angeles underworld.
evaluation_notes: Tests stylized silence, synthwave mood, and sudden explosive violence matching.

title: The Lighthouse
selection_rationale: 1890s New England maritime folklore, psychological isolation, descent into madness.
evaluation_notes: Tests folk horror, psychological isolation, and literary archaic prose.

title: Manchester by the Sea
selection_rationale: Unresolved tragic grief, Massachusetts coastal realism, guilt-ridden parenting trauma.
evaluation_notes: Tests raw emotional realism and unhealed trauma over dramatic catharsis tropes.

title: Ex Machina
selection_rationale: Isolated mountain compound chamber piece, Turing test manipulation, AI deceptive intent.
evaluation_notes: Tests intellectual chamber drama, claustrophobia, and AI ethics deception.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
selection_rationale: Surreal romantic memory erasure, non-linear heartbreak, Charlie Kaufman script.
evaluation_notes: Tests non-linear memory manipulation, surrealism, and tragicomic relationship deconstruction.

title: Lady Bird
selection_rationale: Sacramento coming-of-age, tumultuous mother-daughter bond, Catholic school transition.
evaluation_notes: Tests observational teenage domestic realism and maternal conflict dynamics.

title: Breaking Bad
selection_rationale: High school chemistry teacher cancer diagnosis, meth empire moral descent, crime tragedy.
evaluation_notes: Tests serialized moral corruption arcs and high-stakes criminal tradecraft.

title: Succession
selection_rationale: Media dynasty corporate warfare, Shakespearean sibling cruelty, emotional abuse satire.
evaluation_notes: Tests corporate boardroom Machiavellian satire and dysfunctional wealth trauma.

title: Better Call Saul
selection_rationale: Legal procedural tragedy, moral erosion of a public defender, con-artist relationship.
evaluation_notes: Tests tragic character degeneration, legal procedural depth, and meticulous pacing.

title: Dark
selection_rationale: Small German town missing children, multi-generational time loops, existential paradox.
evaluation_notes: Tests complex non-linear time travel family webs and German-language sci-fi gloom.

title: The Sopranos
selection_rationale: New Jersey mob boss in psychotherapy, suburban existential dread, panic attacks.
evaluation_notes: Tests psychological mafia deconstruction and mundane suburban neurosis.

title: Severance
selection_rationale: Dystopian corporate brain bifurcation, workplace alienation, surreal mystery box.
evaluation_notes: Tests dystopian corporate satire, identity fracture, and retro-futuristic thriller tropes.

title: Chernobyl
selection_rationale: Soviet nuclear disaster miniseries, bureaucratic deceit, radiation cleanup heroism.
evaluation_notes: Tests historical industrial catastrophe, Soviet institutional failure, and docudrama tension.

title: Fargo
selection_rationale: Midwestern polite noir anthology, quirky black comedy, banal evil vs. moral decency.
evaluation_notes: Tests Coen-esque regional black comedy and violent suburban criminal blunders.

title: Fleabag
selection_rationale: Meta-fourth-wall breaking London dark comedy, hypersexual deflection, unspoken grief.
evaluation_notes: Tests direct address comedy masking deep guilt, grief, and intimate confession.

title: The Wire
selection_rationale: Baltimore institutional sociology, police wiretaps, school system decay, drug trade web.
evaluation_notes: Tests institutional sociopolitical realism and non-judgmental macro-systemic decay.

title: Primer
selection_rationale: Ultra-complex non-linear time machine mechanics, jargon-heavy dialogue, micro-budget.
evaluation_notes: Tests temporal mechanics comprehension vs. superficial sci-fi action confusion.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
selection_rationale: Sparse dialogue, meditative visual pacing, philosophical AI and cosmic evolution mystery.
evaluation_notes: Tests abstract non-verbal narrative mapping vs. standard sci-fi pulp action.

title: The Zone of Interest
selection_rationale: Domestic mundane family life adjacent to Auschwitz wall, acoustic off-screen horror.
evaluation_notes: Tests severe tonal dissonance (idyllic domesticity vs. genocide ambient audio).

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
selection_rationale: Absurdist kung fu multiverse collision, hot dog fingers, existential tax audit drama.
evaluation_notes: Tests multi-genre collision (absurd comedy + martial arts + immigrant family trauma).

title: Twin Peaks: The Return
selection_rationale: Avant-garde surrealist television, non-sequitur logic, terrifying cosmic dreamscapes.
evaluation_notes: Tests David Lynch surrealism vs. conventional murder mystery police procedurals.

title: Samsara
selection_rationale: Non-verbal visual essay, global humanity and industrial montage, zero dialogue.
evaluation_notes: Tests semantic clustering without narrative plot lines, cast anchors, or dialogue text.

title: Coherence
selection_rationale: Dinner party comet pass, branching quantum decoherence, improvised micro-budget.
evaluation_notes: Tests quantum parallel reality chamber piece vs. conventional horror/slasher.

title: BoJack Horseman
selection_rationale: Anthropomorphic animated animal satire evolving into severe existential clinical depression.
evaluation_notes: Tests cartoon animation format vs. heavy psychological addiction/suicide drama.

title: Under the Skin
selection_rationale: Alien predatory detachment in Glasgow, sensory Glasgow sound design, minimal speech.
evaluation_notes: Tests alien body horror and sensory dread vs. conventional alien invasion tropes.

title: Perfect Blue
selection_rationale: Psychological thriller anime, pop idol stalker, disorienting reality-fiction blurring.
evaluation_notes: Tests animated medium vs. intense psychological Hitchcockian adult thriller themes.
